Two Decades of Acacia, and a New Chapter in Pine

Acacia has been the heart of our forest for more than twenty years; pine is our newest planting.

Tân Liên Thành began growing acacia more than 20 years ago, and it has remained our main wood ever since — the foundation of everything we supply. More recently, we began cultivating pine as well, adding a second species to our forest.

Acacia continues to be the backbone of our yard, grown on a mature, well-established cycle built over two decades. Pine, by contrast, is still young in our forest — planted only a couple of years ago — and is just beginning its growth alongside our established acacia stands.

Acacia and Pine, One Growing Forest

Acacia, our long-established main wood, now joined by pine, a recent addition to our forest.

Acacia

Acacia mangium

Our main wood, cultivated for over 20 years. Straight-grained and durable, with a growth cycle well suited to steady, dependable supply.

Suited to: framing, plywood, furniture cores

Pine

Pinus

Our newest planting, introduced just a couple of years ago. Fast-growing and already establishing well — lightweight, cost-effective, and easy to finish.

Suited to: formwork, framing, pallets

Our Process, From Forest to Delivery

A disciplined three-stage process, refined over two decades.

01

Plant & Cultivate

We've cultivated acacia, our main wood, for over 20 years, and in recent years began planting pine to grow our forest further.

02

Harvest

Trees are selectively harvested once mature, preserving the health and productivity of the forest for the next generation.

03

Kiln Dry

Wood is kiln-dried to a standard 10–12% moisture content, prepared for use in any climate.
